{{Quote|Two years ago, Ri'kan was part of a group helping the Imps on Belsavis. They were good--experienced, skilled, all that. The Republic hired their own team to stop them. Our-- Our sister, Layla, was in charge. There were casualties, for both sides. The Imp mission failed, but Ri'kan escaped. Layla didn't make it.|[[Rass Ordo]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Layla Ordo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a member of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Ordo]]. Sister to [[Jekiah Ordo|Jekiah]] and [[Rass Ordo]], she was killed during an [[Belsavis operation|operation]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />
